thread:
acme_integration_team: Hey @maya, after the latest model rollout our tool-calls started failing with schema validation errors. This began ~10m after the canary rolled.

maya_support: Thanks — can you paste the raw request + error? Also which model variant are you pinned to?

acme_integration_team: Request sample:
```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "rwd-llm-epoch-4f",
  "input": "Get weather for 94103",
  "tools": [{"name": "weather_lookup", "args": {}}]
}
```
Response error:
```
400 Bad Request - tool_call_schema: missing required field 'location' for tool weather_lookup
```
We used to be able to pass empty args and the tool would be chosen with defaults. Now the model insists on a location arg.

maya_support: Got it. Do you have a repro with curl + headers we can forward to eng? Any recent SDK changes?

acme_integration_team: No SDK change on our side. Quick curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-llm-epoch-4f","input":"Find stores","tools":[{"name":"store_search","args":{}}]}'
```
Same schema error for store_search missing 'zip' field.

oliver_dev: tagging eng-ml. From the error it looks like the model is returning a tool selection payload that includes args validation rules now. Did the canary change the tool-caller proto?

sara_ml: I checked the canary rollout logs (deployer-bot reported 1771043000) — the new model binary (rwd-llm-epoch-4f) includes an updated function-calling schema enforcement patch. It tightened required fields for some tools. That explains the sudden validation failures for empty args.

nina_prod: Is this only on the canary or did it reach production? deploy-bot: canary rollout 1771043000 -> 20% host group started at 2026-03-17T14:03:20Z. No rollout to 100% yet.

maya_support: Good to know it's canary-limited. Acme is on a route that hit a canary host. Can we provide a quick mitigation so their calls don't error?

oliver_dev: Two options: 1) Change server-side tool-call fallback: if model returns args missing -> inject empty defaults and forward to tool runtime (fast fix). 2) Roll the canary back to previous model image while we adjust schema compatibility.

sara_ml: Adding to that — the new model's tool-choice heuristics also prefer a stricter match, so in some cases it chooses a different tool variant (e.g., store_search_v2) which requires extra fields. That explains the tool_choice diffs.

acme_integration_team: We need a temporary fix ASAP. Option 1 would be ideal. We can also patch our client to always send location/zip but that touches many customers.

oliver_dev: I'll put a small compatibility shim into the inference gateway: if model_tool.args is {} but tool schema lists required fields, we will call the older tool interface with empty strings for those fields (e.g., {"zip":""}). Pushing a canary for that shim now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: inference-gateway/compat-shim canary -> id 1771043500

maya_support: Thanks. Acme can you test once the shim canary lands?

acme_integration_team: Testing... still failing on one host, passed on another. Looks like partial rollout. Error now: "tool_call: selected store_search_v2 but args malformed: zip must be numeric"

oliver_dev: Shim is doing best-effort string injection. For numeric fields we were passing empty string which fails validation. I'll update shim to inject 0 for numeric required fields. Will push 1771043600.

deploy-bot: deploy started: inference-gateway/compat-shim patch -> id 1771043599

acme_integration_team: Confirming — all tests passing on our side now. No more 400s. Thanks!

sara_ml: For the long term we should revert the model change that tightened function-calling schemas without a compatibility flag. Nina, recommend rolling the model canary back to previous image (rwd-llm-epoch-3z) until we coordinate schema rollout with dev & partners.

nina_prod: Agreed. Initiating rollback of canary pool. deploy-bot: rollback started: model-rollout 1771043000 -> target rwd-llm-epoch-3z at 2026-03-17T14:07:00Z

maya_support: I'll send an update to Acme with the mitigation steps and ETA for full rollback. Acme: really appreciate the quick debugging and patience. :heart:

acme_integration_team: Thanks everyone. Quick ask — can you surface a release note or flag next time so we can opt into stricter schema? We rely on empty-args behavior.

sara_ml: Yes — action items: 1) Rollback canary (in progress). 2) Add compatibility mode toggle for stricter schema in model config. 3) Update developer docs and changelog for function-calling schema changes. 4) Follow up with customers who hit canary.

oliver_dev: I'll follow up with a postmortem in eng channel once rollback completes.

maya_support: Marking resolved for now. Reopen if you see more errors.

acme_integration_team: Closing on our end. Appreciate the fast response! :thumbsup:
